descripcion: At A2 you compare two things with simple comparative adjectives like bigger and more expensive. Superlatives and weighted, qualified comparisons come at higher levels, once this basic form is automatic.

ejemplos.texto: This bag is bigger than that one.
This phone is more expensive than mine.

notas: Short adjectives take -er: bigger, cheaper, faster.
Long adjectives take more: more expensive, more interesting.
Than is needed after every comparative.

contraste.es: El español compara con más…que, lo cual se transfiere bien al concepto general, aunque la forma -er del inglés para adjetivos cortos no tenga equivalente morfológico.

errores: Using more with a short adjective.
autochequeo: Is than used after every comparative?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on comparatives. Check than and the -er/more forms, and check whether the comparison sounds natural. Do not rewrite the text. Flag anything unclear.
